UP Kaushal Vikas Mission Block Program Manager Online Form 2026 – Full Details

UP Rojgar Sangam (Sewayojan) Portal has released the notification for the post of Block Program Manager in the Department of Uttar Pradesh Kaushal Vikas Mission. This recruitment has been issued for 275 posts. The online application process for UP Kaushal Vikas Mission Block Program Manager Recruitment 2026 has started on 18 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 26 September 2026. How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.

  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
